groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.688% and the 10Y at 5.001%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -3.23% over five sessions and -4.68% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +3.36% at about $116.97, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-27/100, 63% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is healthy market breadth on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is -0.01% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -27/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -48 → now -27; open -29 → now -27 (improved 2 points).

The main live drivers are Breadth are supportive: After-hours · After-hours breadth: 51/73 advancing (70%) · 22 declining · 0 flat. It changed from mixed to positive after the baseline snapshot. The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.688% (+5.3 bp vs prev close). Volatility are a headwind: VXN 28.46 (-0.91%) | VIX 19.45 (+2.21%). It changed from mixed to negative after the baseline snapshot.
